fields.System.Title: INT-203 — Publish stock adjustments
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a finance team member, I want to be told when stock is written on or off, so that
the value of what we hold stays correct in the accounts.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a posted adjustment, then an event is written to the outbox carrying product,
  • quantity, direction, reason code, and the approver.
  • - Given an adjustment from a count, then the event identifies it as a count correction
  • and links to the count task.
  • - Given a scrap or write-off, then the event is distinguishable from a count correction
  • — they post differently.
  • - Given the event, then it is published only after the adjustment commits.
  • - Given duplicate delivery, then consumers deduplicate on event_id.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, inventory, counting |
| Tables | outbox, adjustment |
| Risks | Wrong financial postings from missing reason codes ([doc 05 WF 13](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | integration · event assertion |
